lessons.title: 6. Functions and first tests
lessons.concept: A function turns inputs into a result. A test checks expected behavior.

explanation.text: def defines the function; return returns its result. ValueError signals invalid input. assert suits this test exercise, not production input validation because it can be disabled. Also try a zero and then a negative quantity.

codeExample.code:
def total(price_cents: int, quantity: int) -> int:
    if price_cents < 0 or quantity < 0:
        raise ValueError("Les valeurs doivent être positives ou nulles")
    return price_cents * quantity

assert total(19900, 2) == 39800
assert total(19900, 0) == 0
print("Tests OK")

exercise.task: Copy the code into lesson.py. Run it, then change the expected result 39800 to 1 to see the test fail.
hints: A function turns inputs into a result. A test checks expected behavior.
exercise.solution: The first run prints Tests OK. The second raises AssertionError; then restore the correct value.

summary: The first run prints Tests OK. The second raises AssertionError; then restore the correct value.

teaching.why: def defines the function; return returns its result. ValueError signals invalid input. assert suits this test exercise, not production input validation because it can be disabled. Also try a zero and then a negative quantity.

lessons.title: 16. Towards a professional project
lessons.concept: Coding also means validating inputs, testing failures and explaining your choices.

explanation.text: Next: modules and classes → type hints → pytest → Pydantic input models → SQL and migrations → authentication → background jobs → logs and deployment. For each topic, build a small feature and test a failure before moving on.

Before using real data: authenticate private routes, rate-limit requests and check access. Keep keys in server environment variables. Host Python on a suitable service, remove --reload and configure HTTPS, PYTHON_API_URL, deadlines and logs. This guide prepares the project; it does not automatically deploy a Python service.
